breaking.member: DataGrid, Chart, Carousel, NodeGraph, SplitView, table, data-list, tree, pagination, calendar, card, creator-tools
breaking.change: The data and tool panels are redrawn in the HUD's language: each stands on a cut smoked-glass plate with a lit top edge, headings are small tracked capitals over a faint rule, figures are condensed and tabular, and a chosen row is washed in the accent from its leading edge, which carries a lit bar. DataGrid's numeric columns read as figures, and in a shell narrower than 480 px each row becomes a two-line card (the first column and the last on one line, the others as a caption under them) instead of cutting every column to an ellipsis; its Retry is the primary button. Chart's bars lean and are lit along their top, its line series is gold, and a long category name wraps under its bar. Carousel shows one page at a time with the next beyond its edge, its place as leaning pips between 44 px cut arrow keys. NodeGraph's well is the plate under a faint dot grid with accent links and a lit current node. SplitView's grip is lit in the accent. The table's first column is a name and the others are end-aligned figures. data-list rows start-align their words. tree rows carry indent guides, and the selected row is washed in the accent instead of being a primary button. pagination and calendar use cut keys and 44 px targets; today is lit in the accent, and a marked day carries a gold diamond instead of a bar at its foot. card is a pressable plate whose body is no longer clamped to three lines. creator-tools' tools are a segmented switch lit in the accent, and on a portrait phone its panel tabs are one strip that scrolls sideways with 44 px targets instead of wrapping. Parts, props and strings are unchanged.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed these panels through their row, cell, frame or band roles sets the --data-* and --hud-plate-* tokens instead. A style that dressed a tree's selected row through `#Item[variant="primary"]` dresses `.row[aria-selected="true"]`. A game that relied on card clamping its body keeps its body short.

fixed.summary: Chart's category names were cut at 150 % text and its gridlines were reported as overlapping its bars; Carousel's next page overflowed its box; a long card title was cut and its body truncated. Each now fits or wraps whole.
